content.title: Geometric Character Tunnel | Identity Hook, Module Travel, Ring Return
content.summary: A radio engineer moves through dial rings, waveform cubes and signal grids before ring closure. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: At least three identity anchors precede the module changes. + Each geometry module carries one action only. + Face, hair and wardrobe remain stable. + Color wipes change the field, not the identity. + The opening ring motif returns around the full subject.
quick_start.recommended_input: Introduce an original adult radio engineer through one amber eye, silver headphone arc and fingertip on a dial. Rotate one waveform cube and one black grid module around the stable face, jacket and headphones. Return the teal dial ring around the full engineer and two registered echo silhouettes, then hold.
required_anchors: At least three identity anchors precede the module changes.
Each geometry module carries one action only.
Color wipes change the field, not the identity.
The opening ring motif returns around the full subject.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A radio engineer moves through dial rings, waveform cubes and signal grids before ring closure. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
